newsitem.title: USA: Multicanal S.A. issues $250 mln debt in two parts.
newsitem.headline: Multicanal S.A. issues $250 mln debt in two parts.

text.p: The following global debt issue from Argentina's Multicanal S.A. was priced in two tranches on Monday, according to co-lead manager Bank of Boston. Credit Suisse First Boston also co-led the deal.
Both tranches were issued at the tight side of price talk bandied about prior to Monday, the dealer said.
